titulo: Dollar General, Denny's and Carter's: a reported number next to a closing plan
caption:
Dollar General, Denny's and Carter's: a reported number next to a closing plan

From the archive: 2024 to 2025.

Carter's, Oct 27, 2025
The math: $47.2 million (dividends paid, first three quarters of fiscal 2025) ÷ about 150 (stores in the plan over three years, Oct 2025) = about $314,666 of three quarters of dividends per store in the Oct 2025 plan

Denny's, Jan 13, 2025
The math: $11.2 million (allocated to share repurchases, fiscal 2024) ÷ 88 (Denny's restaurants closed in fiscal 2024; 87 were franchised) = about $127,272 of fiscal 2024 repurchases per restaurant closed

Dollar General, Mar 13, 2025
The math: $1.12 billion (net income, fiscal 2024) ÷ 141 (stores in the closing plan of Mar 2025 (96 Dollar General, 45 pOpshelf)) = about $7.98 million of fiscal 2024 net income per store in the Mar 2025 plan

Closing, closure, closures. Here is the closings column. (Our take.)

Sources: Carter's, Form 8-K, filed Oct 27, 2025; Denny's, Form 8-K, filed Jan 13, 2025; Denny's, Form 8-K, filed Feb 12, 2025; Dollar General, Form 8-K, filed Mar 13, 2025.

Slide 5 of 7. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Title: How we count. For each company, the number A and the number B from its filing (shortened, never rounded up), with the form and the date, and the rule: each result is divided and never rounded up; anything approximate says about.

Slide 6 of 7. Cobalt blue poster with white type. Title: What this does not say. Dollar General: 141 is 96 Dollar General and 45 pOpshelf stores in its plan. Its fiscal 2024 ended before the closings are planned, in the first quarter of fiscal 2025. Denny's: 87 of the 88 restaurants closed in fiscal 2024 were franchised. One was company-owned. Its $11.2 million is what the company says it allocated to repurchases. Carter's: the $47.2 million in dividends covers three quarters. Its approximately 150 stores are a plan over three years. Our take: Closing, closure, closures. Here is the closings column.
